error-handler.name: global-error-handler
error-handler.doc:name: Global Error Handler
error-handler.doc:description: Centralized error handler covering all negative scenarios: validation (400), auth (401), token (403), connectivity (503), and internal errors (500)

on-error-propagate.doc:name: 400 Bad Request
on-error-propagate.doc:description: Handles missing access_token, malformed request body, or Keycloak 400 - returns INVALID_REQUEST JSON

ee:transform.doc:name: Build 400 Response
ee:transform.doc:description: Sets payload to INVALID_REQUEST JSON and httpStatus variable to 400

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "error": "INVALID_REQUEST", "description": error.description default "The request is malformed or missing required parameters" }

on-error-propagate.doc:name: 401 Unauthorized
on-error-propagate.doc:description: Handles Keycloak 401 - invalid client ID or secret - returns INVALID_CLIENT JSON

ee:transform.doc:name: Build 401 Response
ee:transform.doc:description: Sets payload to INVALID_CLIENT JSON and httpStatus variable to 401

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "error": "INVALID_CLIENT", "description": error.description default "Client authentication failed - verify client ID and secret in secure properties" }

on-error-propagate.doc:name: 403 Forbidden
on-error-propagate.doc:description: Handles Keycloak 403 forbidden response - returns INVALID_TOKEN JSON

ee:transform.doc:name: Build 403 Response
ee:transform.doc:description: Sets payload to INVALID_TOKEN JSON and httpStatus variable to 403

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "error": "INVALID_TOKEN", "description": error.description default "The access token is invalid, expired, or has been revoked" }

on-error-propagate.doc:name: 503 Service Unavailable
on-error-propagate.doc:description: Handles Keycloak connectivity failures, timeouts, or unavailability - returns SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE JSON

ee:transform.doc:name: Build 503 Response
ee:transform.doc:description: Sets payload to SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE JSON and httpStatus variable to 503

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "error": "SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE", "description": error.description default "Keycloak authorization server is unreachable or timed out - please try again later" }

on-error-propagate.doc:name: 500 Internal Server Error
on-error-propagate.doc:description: Catch-all handler for any other unexpected errors - returns INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR JSON

ee:transform.doc:name: Build 500 Response
ee:transform.doc:description: Sets payload to INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR JSON and httpStatus variable to 500

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "error": "INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR", "description": error.description default "An unexpected internal error occurred" }
